title: Capable Teacher, Myopic Scorer: Reward-Free Teacher Repair for Agentic On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.28586v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agentic on-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student agent on its own trajectories while a teacher scores every token. A natural explanation of where it goes wrong is compounding error: the student's mistakes carry its trajectories beyond the region where the teacher is reliable, so recent methods keep training inside that region, through episode-length curricula, teacher-guided turns, prefix replay, or teacher intervention where the two disagree. We show this explanation is incomplete. From the states where the student departs most from the teacher, the teacher's own takeovers still finish the task, yet the student trained on its token scores keeps running out of turns. We attribute this to the myopia of next-token scoring. The teacher rates each token without seeing where the episode ends, so its scores let through the safe, delaying moves that outcome-based RL would punish with zero reward, a penalty agentic OPD lacks. translated_title: 有能力的教师，短视的评分者：面向智能体在线策略蒸馏的无奖励教师修复
translated_abstract: 智能体在线策略蒸馏（OPD）让学生智能体在自己的轨迹上进行训练，同时由教师模型对每个 token 进行评分。对其失败原因的一种自然解释是误差累积：学生的错误使其轨迹偏离了教师可靠的区域，因此近期的方法通过回合长度课程、教师引导轮次、前缀回放或在师生分歧处进行教师干预等方式，将训练保持在该区域内。我们证明这种解释是不完整的。在学生最偏离教师的状态下，由教师自己接管仍然能够完成任务，然而基于教师 token 评分训练出的学生却总是耗尽回合数。我们将此归因于下一 token 评分的短视性。教师在评分时看不到回合的最终结局，因此其评分放过了那些安全却拖延的行动，而基于结果的强化学习（RL）会以零奖励惩罚这类行动——这种惩罚机制正是智能体 OPD 所缺乏的。我们将此称为
tldr: 论文揭示智能体在线策略蒸馏（OPD）失败的根源不仅是误差累积，更在于教师逐 token 评分的“短视性”——其评分看不到回合结局，从而放过了安全却拖延的行动，并据此提出了一种无需奖励的教师修复方法。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that agentic on-policy distillation fails not merely from compounding error but from the myopia of next-token teacher scoring—which approves safe, delaying moves that outcome-based RL would punish—and proposes a reward-free teacher repair method to address it.
